# Work Day Notice — Saturday 14 November 2026

Dear Members,

The committee has scheduled our autumn work day for:

**Date:** Saturday 14 November 2026  
**Time:** 09:30 – 12:30

## What's happening

- General garden tidy-up and winter preparation
- Tool-sharpening service available from **10:00** (booked by Nell)
- Water system will be shut off for winter by Wren on the day

## What to bring

- **Gloves** (required)
- Any personal tools you prefer to use

## What's provided

- Soup will be supplied by the club

## Notes

- This is the last work day before winter closure at end of November
- Please attend if you can — many hands make light work

See you there!

Collegica Committee
